impact: Memory names bouncing off extreme valuations is a supportive sign for MU, DRAM and SNXX, but continued foreign selling over US data-centre regulation fears keeps the rebound fragile.
summary: Korea's Kospi rose about 1.2% to 5,118 Monday morning after a 6% Friday drop and a near-12% weekly loss. SK Hynix traded up 4.15% and Samsung up 2.49% as retail buyers stepped in, while foreign investors sold for a seventh straight session. Brokers said forward P/Es of 2.6x (SK Hynix) and 3.1x (Samsung) are below their lows since 2013.
title: Kospi rebounds to 5,118; SK Hynix up 4.2%, Samsung up 2.5%
